description: This file defines the FooterSubController class within the Goteo project's admin namespace. It manages CRUD operations and permissions for footer-related content, interacting with models and handling different actions such as listing, adding, moving, and removing footer posts.

classes.name: FooterSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing footer-related posts including listing, adding, editing, moving, and deleting footer entries with permission checks.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user with specific roles can access footer management, limited to master nodes and superadmins.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the listing of footer posts, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a footer post up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a footer post down in order.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Prepares for adding a new footer post.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing footer post.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method handling various footer post operations based on action parameter, including form submissions, reordering, and retrieval.
